moulding_clearance.below_moulding_top_rule: For X from 0 to 25.4 mm, no bracket material may extend below Y=-32 mm. Farther out, downward design space is free of this moulding constraint.
moulding_clearance.interpretation: Preserve G's lower wall locating corner and a horizontal underside for at least one inch from the wall. This replaces the earlier 15 mm estimate; it is not extra projection beyond the front rod or bracket tip.
moulding_clearance.scope: Nominal spatial clearance only. Contact with moulding supplies no assumed structural support. Physical fit remains to be checked.

note: Projected area is not printed mass. Moulding is a locating datum, with no assumed structural support.
